newsitem.title: USA: NY physical coffee - spot market remains subdued.
newsitem.headline: NY physical coffee - spot market remains subdued.

text.p: Spot business remained sluggish on the New York physical market this week, reflecting an uncertain futures market and scant roaster participation, traders said.
"Roasters are sitting back and hoping the "C" market continues to go down," one trader said. "Most of the spot business is fill-in and small quantities."
With roasters' needs fairly well met through the spring and the heavy roasting period coming to close, traders expected business to remain slow.
"April is going to be a very slow roasting period," another trader said. "The majority of roasters are covered through April and May."
Although the supply situation remains tight, traders said high prices on the futures market had lured more coffee to the market.

"What we've seen is a change in attitude by producers that this is not a bad level to sell coffee, " a trader said. "Brazil has been selling coffee more aggressively and Colombia trying to get rid of its old stocks."
